tests.frontend_scope: Initial state, all phases through 14 months, energy shock and closure

browser.history_selection: M1 selected while M2 is completed

figure.review: Six full-horizon comparison panels checked; nominal GDP approximation and trailing monthly means labeled

limits: GDP is an illustrative nominal proxy using manufacturing-cost inventory and paid public payroll; not official national accounts
Goods production per scheduled private FTE at fixed prices is not official GDP per hour
Birth rates are unknown because no population or age structure exists
100 percent consumption is a diagnostic intervention and does not become the default
The 100-percent profile borrows earlier and temporarily carries more debt; end-month comparisons alone are incomplete
